thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'helion-dedpool' - GPU node preempted (spot). affected tenants: aurora-corp. Auto-eviction triggered. severity: P2

sarah (oncall): seeing a spike in ML task failures for aurora-corp, ~30% of their requests returning 503s. Node id: gnode-helion-12.

rahul: I have logs, GPU was reclaimed by cloud provider, kernel shows TDR then vm shutdown. Not seeing PCIe errors, looks like spot termination.

emily: customer CS pinged: "we're seeing timeouts in our VPC - conversation thread linked" <https://aurora.example.com/incidents/1234> 

carlos (aurora-ops): Confirmed, we're getting alerts from our side too. Can you isolate our tenant? Need to avoid cross-tenant regression.

kevin (infra): Initiating tenant isolation now: moving aurora-corp traffic off gnode-helion-12. Will start live-migration to hot-standby nodes.

ops-sre: steps we should follow: 1) drain node 2) evict tenant workloads 3) attach replacement GPU 4) verify model KV caches warm.

rahul: drain command ready:```bash
kubectl cordon gnode-helion-12
kubectl drain gnode-helion-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

sarah (oncall): I'm executing the drain, will monitor token-level latencies and error rates. tagging @kevin.

kevin (infra): ack. running drain now. moving aurora-corp routes to reserved pool 'helion-standby-a'. routing policy: prefer dedicated fallback, then hosted.

pd-bot: Paging sarah (oncall), rahul: Incident escalation requires >=1 senior SRE on call for 30m due to customer impact.

emily: FYI CS update going out: "We're aware of degraded inference for Aurora, routing to standby. ETA 25-40m for stable service" 

carlos (aurora-ops): Thanks. Can you confirm whether model versions will be affected? We run pinned model v2.1 in the dedicated pool.

rahul: pinned versions are available on standby nodes. We'll avoid model swap. There may be transient KV cache misses that increase cold-start latency ~200-400ms.

ops-sre: Noting automatic fallback: if standby capacity insufficient, requests will overflow to hosted variants (quantized). That is enabled for aurora-corp.

sarah (oncall): error rate dropped to 12% after the first tranche of traffic moved. Token latencies still elevated: p50 up 120ms -> 230ms.

kevin (infra): Replacement node request submitted to cloud: spot replacement requested with tactics: use non-spot if spot capacity unstable for this tenant. Marking replacement priority high.

rahul: I'm starting a rolling warmup for model caches on helion-standby-a:```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-warmup/runs -d '{"model":"gpt-small","tenant":"aurora-corp","tokens":1024}'
```

emily: CS to Aurora: "We've routed to standby nodes to restore stability. Some requests may be slightly slower for a short period while caches warm. We'll send another update when services are fully restored." :thumbsup:

carlos (aurora-ops): ok please include if any log artifacts are needed for our postmortem. We have audit windows for 18:00 UTC.

ops-sre: we'll capture node-level metrics (GPU util, PCIe errors, eviction reason) and prefix them to the incident ticket.

pd-bot: SARAH acknowledged by kevin (infra). On-call handover to kevin in 25m for escalation path.

sarah (oncall): handing off. rahul and kevin are primary. I'm logging runbook steps in the incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incident/1758881234

rahul: replacement node spun up as non-spot at 1758883200, attaching to dedpool. Running smoke tests.

kevin (infra): smoke tests green for aurora routes on new node. beginning gradual traffic shift back. routing policy: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 5m windows.

emily: CS: updated Aurora with ETA 15m for full restoration. They want a post-incident call if SLA breach.

carlos (aurora-ops): we'll be on the call if needed. appreciate the quick pivot.

ops-sre: monitoring shows error rate now 1.2%, latency back to baseline over last 10m. Closing mitigation: node replaced with non-spot. Recommend we mark this dedpool node as "prefer-non-spot" for aurora-corp going forward in their profile.

sarah (oncall): agreed. creating follow-up action item: update tenant policy to prefer-non-spot for critical customers + add automated warmup on replacement.

rahul: creating incident ticket with root cause: cloud spot reclaim => node preempted => failover worked, replacement non-spot added. Attach logs + metrics.

emily: CS will schedule postmortem call with Aurora for tomorrow 1700 UTC.

pd-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: all services stable. Thank you. :white_check_mark:
